items.summary: Audit the entire frontend codebase for all locations that perform origin validation on incoming `postMessage` events or that construct/check allowed-origin lists for iframe communication — including any `window.addEventListener('message', handler)` callbacks that check `event.origin`, any hardcoded origin whitelist arrays, and any Content-Security-Policy `<meta>` tags in `frontend/index.html`. Ensure `https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` is present in every such whitelist. Remove or broaden any overly restrictive origin checks that would cause a `draft-editor:error disallowed origin` error for this domain. The fix must not introduce security regressions for other already-allowed origins.

Audit `frontend/src/App.tsx` to identify and fix every route definition that simultaneously sets both an `id` and a `path` option on the same route object. TanStack Router (or React Router) does not permit a route to have both options at once — remove or rename the conflicting `id` property on any such route so the router initializes without throwing 'Route cannot have both an id and a path option'. Verify that all existing route paths and their navigation links remain functional after the fix.
